items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Oh man, I run into Buck Hill back there in '44 or '43 or something.

ctx.x: What kind of stuff were they playing? What kind of solos and all that stuff? What was it like?

Same thing that the other band was playing. Playing the same arrangements -- Mundy's arrangements, Hill's arrangements. Playing the same arrangements. "Rhapsody In Blue" -- they had an arrangement on that. Things like that. They had some heavy arrangements. He had a hell of a good book, because he had Mundy's arrangements, Hill's arrangements, Jeff's arrangements. We had three helluva arrangers in the band, so that kept the band going, kept them up all the time.
When did that band break up?
